definitions.gloss: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)
definitions.explanation: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)

examples.japanese: このチケットは{転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Resale of this ticket is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}の{法律|ほうりつ}が{施行|しこう}された。
examples.english: A law prohibiting resale was enacted.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}コンサートのチケットが{高額|こうがく}{転売|てんばい}される{問題|もんだい}を{受|う}け、{転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}{対策|たいさく}が{強化|きょうか}された。
examples.english: In response to the problem of popular concert tickets being resold at inflated prices, anti-resale measures were strengthened.

notes:
A compound of {転売|てんばい} (resale) and {禁止|きんし} (prohibition). Extremely common in modern Japan, appearing on tickets, product packaging, and event websites. The issue of scalping ({転売|てんばい}{屋|や} — scalper) became prominent enough that Japan enacted a specific anti-scalping law for entertainment tickets in 2019.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}{対策|たいさく} — anti-resale measures
- {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}{法|ほう} — anti-resale law
- {高額|こうがく}{転売|てんばい} — resale at an inflated price
- {転売|てんばい}{目的|もくてき}の{購入|こうにゅう} — purchasing for the purpose of resale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転売|てんばい} — resale (the act itself)
- ダフ{行為|こうい} — scalping (older term, from ダフ{屋|や})
- {不正|ふせい}{転売|てんばい} — illegal resale
